required_assumptions: F(z)=s(z) is a unary function of the declared symbol z.
p and q are distinct formal symbols; the denominator p-q is kept symbolic and is not assumed to vanish.
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The three catalog expressions share the same undeclared unary function s evaluated at the two formal symbols p and q. G0002 and G0003 are direct evaluations of F, while G0001 is an explicit symmetric combination of these evaluations divided by p-q. This gives one latent object and explicit operators that reconstruct all non-identical members without simplifying the source expression.
